name: Surge of Lightning
title: Razor: Surge of Lightning
desc: "Through the long years, the immortal witch has lost more than she can ever count. This is no exaggeration, for nothing in this world, once lost, can truly be found again. In distant worlds, even children raised together by wolves would one day bare their fangs at each other. But at least here in this world, the wolves' child may still find the warmth of home."
in_play_description: While your Razor has The Wolf Within attached with this card equipped, DMG dealt by your The Wolf Within is increased by 1.

skills.desc:
Combat Action: When your active character is Razor, equip this card.
If your Razor does not have The Wolf Within attached, attach The Wolf Within with 1 Duration.
While your Razor has The Wolf Within attached with this card equipped, DMG dealt by your The Wolf Within is increased by 1.
(You must have Razor in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
